# react-remove-scroll-bar 2.3.8

The installed npm package declares MIT and author Anton Korzunov but omits a
LICENSE file. Its npm `gitHead` is `b3b1287aad81def2e2ae707274b74531b61ddbaf`,
which also has no LICENSE file. The full MIT text is copied without changes from
the author's later commit adding that file:
https://github.com/theKashey/react-remove-scroll-bar/blob/7301c160fda44cb8cf2b9fdfde61efad35736196/LICENSE

The build fallback is scoped to this exact package version. A different missing
license fails the build and needs review; it does not reuse this text silently.
